scope: Three post-selected exposed development cases; retained Codex construction outputs are stage one. Tests workflow feasibility, not unbiased repair efficacy or new independent construction.
procedure: Exact retained construction -> one fresh Codex review with source, actual field semantics and deterministic readback -> existing repair_request local closure -> one fresh Codex patch if requested -> existing apply_record_patch and compile -> post-output author source audit. No reference or old audit is given to reviewer/patcher.
decision_rules: Report detection, completed repair, wrong-to-correct, correct-to-wrong and transitions to unresolved separately. Compilation or reviewer approval does not certify repair.
Evaluate all original source meanings and extras. Preserve Pandoc wording ambiguity; no forced wider prohibition or reference regrading. Unknown is not a successful semantic repair.
The firmware source-audit pass is a preservation control; any change needs a source-supported reason.
Privilege direct-target correction must preserve source order, exception condition and participants; temporal counterpart is not automatically another direct recipient of the predicate.
No new reviewers or repeated patches after a failure; candidate edits, Discovery, Confirmation and independent human gold remain out of scope.
